In the middle, there's a stack of white plates—looks like a stack of white plates/bowls? It's a stack of white round things, looks like plates stacked.

Now the jars: I see a jar with a purple/blue lid (mustard maybe), a jar with a red checkered lid (chili sauce?), a small jar with red lid, a bottle with silver cap (oil?), a bottle with white cap (honey?).

Let me double check. The jars all appear to have lids on them. Yes, all closed.

Thus D is the most accurate.

Let me reexamine C: "three stacks of paper plates of the same size." There's one stack of white plates (the middle one), and two single patterned plates. Not three stacks. So false.

Thus answer D.

The question asks to respond with only the letter. So "D".
